preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[0] if c.isdigit())])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the array length N is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= 10**5 for x in A) for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1])
preconditions.description: All elements in array A are positive integers between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(A.count(x) <= 2 for x in set(A)) for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1])
preconditions.description: The frequency of each integer in array A is at most 2.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly 2 lines per test case.
The first line of each test case output is a non-negative integer representing the maximum Hamming distance.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_lines[2*i+1].split()) == N for i, N in enumerate([int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[0] if c.isdigit())]))
postconditions.description: The second line of each test case output contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted([int(x) for x in stdout_lines[2*i+1].split()]) == sorted(A) for i, A in enumerate([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1]))
postconditions.description: The array B output for each test case is a permutation of the input array A.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[2*i]) == sum(1 for j in range(len(A)) if A[j] != int(stdout_lines[2*i+1].split()[j])) for i, A in enumerate([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1]))
postconditions.description: The reported Hamming distance equals the actual number of indices where A and B differ.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[2*i]) == max(sum(1 for j in range(len(A)) if A[j] != B[j]) for B in permutations(A)) for i, A in enumerate([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1]))
postconditions.description: The reported Hamming distance is the maximum possible Hamming distance achievable by any permutation of A.
